spec.description: Fleet status, client traffic, role control and native engine metrics for one Prometheus data source.

spec.title: Admission / controller
spec.description: Admission readiness of the selected router and controller execution mode, with trailing-area sparklines. Automatic mode applies eligible role changes; advisory mode records proposed changes.

spec.title: Engine scrapes
spec.description: Scrape status of all configured engine targets, with a trailing-area sparkline.

spec.title: Requests
spec.description: Per-second completed, failed, expired, refused and rejected terminal outcomes with trailing-area sparklines, plus the corresponding totals over the displayed interval on the selected router. Client cancellations count separately.

spec.title: Tokens
spec.description: Per-second prefill and decode token rates with trailing-area sparklines, and the corresponding totals over the displayed interval, across the selected router's fleet.

spec.title: Engine assignments and work
spec.description: Select Engine detail to filter current assignments, resident work and native vLLM load by engine.

spec.expr: max by(iid) ((((sum by(iid) (narwhal_instance_role{job="narwhal-router",instance=~"$router",iid=~"$iid",role="prefill"} and on(job,instance) (up{job="narwhal-router",instance=~"$router"} == 1))) or (0 * sum by(iid) (narwhal_instance_role{job="narwhal-router",instance=~"$router",iid=~"$iid"} and on(job,instance) (up{job="narwhal-router",instance=~"$router"} == 1)))) + 2 * ((sum by(iid) (narwhal_instance_role{job="narwhal-router",instance=~"$router",iid=~"$iid",role="decode"} and on(job,instance) (up{job="narwhal-router",instance=~"$router"} == 1))) or (0 * sum by(iid) (narwhal_instance_role{job="narwhal-router",instance=~"$router",iid=~"$iid"} and on(job,instance) (up{job="narwhal-router",instance=~"$router"} == 1))))) or on(iid) (0 * max by(iid) (up{job="engines",iid=~"$iid"})))

max by(iid) ((narwhal_ejected{job="narwhal-router",instance=~"$router",iid=~"$iid"} and on(job,instance) (up{job="narwhal-router",instance=~"$router"} == 1)) or on(iid) (0 * sum by(iid) (narwhal_instance_role{job="narwhal-router",instance=~"$router",iid=~"$iid"} and on(job,instance) (up{job="narwhal-router",instance=~"$router"} == 1))))

spec.title: Engine role history
spec.description: Routing assignments over time for the selected engines.

spec.expr: ((((sum by(iid) ((narwhal_instance_role{job="narwhal-router",instance=~"$router",iid=~"$iid",role="prefill"} and on(job,instance) (up{job="narwhal-router",instance=~"$router"} == 1)))) or (0 * sum by(iid) ((narwhal_instance_role{job="narwhal-router",instance=~"$router",iid=~"$iid"} and on(job,instance) (up{job="narwhal-router",instance=~"$router"} == 1))))) + 2 * ((sum by(iid) ((narwhal_instance_role{job="narwhal-router",instance=~"$router",iid=~"$iid",role="decode"} and on(job,instance) (up{job="narwhal-router",instance=~"$router"} == 1)))) or (0 * sum by(iid) ((narwhal_instance_role{job="narwhal-router",instance=~"$router",iid=~"$iid"} and on(job,instance) (up{job="narwhal-router",instance=~"$router"} == 1))))))) > 0

spec.title: Arrivals and completions
spec.description: Original arrivals and successful completions per second on the selected router.

spec.title: Request exceptions
spec.description: Request exceptions by type. A request can contribute to multiple counters.

spec.title: Time to first token
spec.description: Router arrival to prefill completion on the selected router. Quantiles use process-local histogram rates; the SLO series comes from the running router configuration.

spec.title: Time per output token
spec.description: Mean decode interval per completed request on the selected router. Quantiles use process-local histogram rates; the SLO series comes from the running router configuration.

spec.title: Request waiting time
spec.description: The selected router's p95 queue wait and admission-seat duration separate waiting from retained request lifetime.

spec.title: Pool pressure
spec.description: Scheduler pressure as a fraction of each pool's latency target, including the decode idle-floor correction.

spec.title: Fleet events
spec.description: Firing Narwhal alerts at page and warning severity, with the affected engine when the alert carries an iid label.

spec.title: Pool assignments
spec.description: Engines assigned to each pool and engines held out by the breaker.

spec.title: Narwhal Orchestrator
